title: Unctuous Egyptian Red Bean Skewers
description: A fatty and molten Egyptian dish featuring anko red bean paste, char grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill, providing an energizing paleo friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the grass fed beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to a safe internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the skewers are grilling, heat the red bean paste in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Once the skewers are cooked, brush them with the heated red bean paste.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
